changelog: Fixed a crash browsing Favorites on low-RAM devices with very large catalogs. Favoriting a US channel now auto-assigns a cable-style number (Basic TV, Movies, Sports, News, Kids blocks) shown next to its name in the mini player; existing favorites were backfilled too. Added custom channel numbers (long-press a US channel), a 5-digit remote channel-jump, and a Restore from Backup File option on login. Back from TV Movies/Series now returns to the bare sidebar, and the sidebar auto-hides after 1 minute idle.
